lines: # 1. túnel até o NexoISP (RouterOS 7 ou mais novo)

/interface wireguard peers add interface=nexoisp public-key="{{.tn.serverPublicKey}}" endpoint-address={{.tn.endpointHost}} endpoint-port={{.tn.endpointPort}} allowed-address={{.tn.serverIp}}/32 persistent-keepalive=25s comment=nexoisp
/ip address add address={{.tn.tunnelIp}}/32 network={{.tn.serverIp}} interface=nexoisp comment=nexoisp
/ip firewall filter add chain=input in-interface=nexoisp protocol=udp dst-port={{.o.coaPort}} action=accept place-before=0 comment="nexoisp: desconexao de sessao"

/radius add service=ppp,hotspot,dhcp address={{.o.host}} secret="{{.o.secret}}" authentication-port={{.o.authPort}} accounting-port={{.o.acctPort}} timeout=3s{{if .tn}} src-address={{.tn.tunnelIp}}{{else}}{{end}} comment=nexoisp
# servidor secundário: o equipamento tenta este se o primeiro não responder

/radius add service=ppp,hotspot,dhcp address={{.o.secondary.host}} secret="{{.o.secret}}" authentication-port={{.o.secondary.authPort}} accounting-port={{.o.secondary.acctPort}} timeout=3s{{if .tn}} src-address={{.tn.tunnelIp}}{{else}}{{end}} comment=nexoisp-2
# opcional, se houver assinantes por IPoE (DHCP) ou hotspot neste equipamento:
# /ip hotspot profile set [find] use-radius=yes radius-accounting=yes radius-interim-update=5m
aaa authentication ppp default group NEXOISP
aaa authorization network default group NEXOISP
aaa accounting network default start-stop group NEXOISP
endereço do par: {{.tn.endpointHost}}:{{.tn.endpointPort}}  |  redes permitidas: {{.tn.serverIp}}/32  |  keepalive: 25 s
Porta de autenticação: {{.o.authPort}}  |  Porta de accounting: {{.o.acctPort}}
# 1. túnel L2TP/IPsec até o NexoISP (RouterOS 6.16 ou mais novo)

/interface l2tp-client add name=nexoisp connect-to={{.tn.endpointHost}} user="{{.l.username}}" password="{{.l.password}}" use-ipsec=yes ipsec-secret="{{.l.psk}}" allow=chap add-default-route=no keepalive-timeout=30 disabled=no comment=nexoisp
/ip firewall filter add chain=input in-interface=nexoisp protocol=udp dst-port={{.o.coaPort}} action=accept place-before=0 comment="nexoisp: desconexao de sessao"
# 2. autenticação pelo túnel (o endereço {{.tn.tunnelIp}} é entregue pelo NexoISP ao conectar)

/radius add service=ppp,hotspot,dhcp address={{.o.host}} secret="{{.o.secret}}" authentication-port={{.o.authPort}} accounting-port={{.o.acctPort}} timeout=3s src-address={{.tn.tunnelIp}} comment=nexoisp

/radius add service=ppp,hotspot,dhcp address={{.o.secondary.host}} secret="{{.o.secret}}" authentication-port={{.o.secondary.authPort}} accounting-port={{.o.secondary.acctPort}} timeout=3s src-address={{.tn.tunnelIp}} comment=nexoisp-2
Túnel L2TP sobre IPsec (configure o cliente L2TP/LAC do equipamento conforme o manual do fabricante)
servidor: {{.tn.endpointHost}}  |  IPsec: IKEv1, modo transporte, chave compartilhada "{{.l.psk}}" (UDP 500 e 4500)
L2TP: UDP 1701 dentro do IPsec  |  usuário: {{.l.username}}  |  senha: {{.l.password}}  |  autenticação: CHAP
endereço entregue a este equipamento: {{.tn.tunnelIp}} (o servidor é {{.tn.serverIp}})
Porta de autenticação: {{.o.authPort}}  |  Porta de accounting: {{.o.acctPort}}
